_note: Sparse Vespers overlay — Jordanville/HTM Psalter rendering of Kathisma I, Section 1 ("Blessed is the Man"). Uses 'impious' rather than 'ungodly', 'hath' rather than 'has', 'Serve ye' rather than 'Serve the Lord', and splits the closing doxology into two verses each followed by Alleluia.

blessedIsTheMan._note: HTM-family Psalter (cf. Holy Trinity Monastery Service Book; Boston Psalter). Per parish practice the closing doxology is sung in two parts — `gloryOnly` then `nowOnly` — each followed by the Alleluia refrain. When both keys are present the assembler emits the split form.
verses: Blessed is the man who hath not walked in the counsel of the impious.
For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous and the way of the impious shall perish.
Serve ye the Lord in fear and rejoice unto him with trembling.
Blessed are all they that trust in Him.
Arise O Lord, save me O my God.
Salvation is of the Lord, and thy blessing is upon thy people.
blessedIsTheMan.gloryOnly: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
blessedIsTheMan.nowOnly: Both now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.
